The only route from Adwa to anything Portuguese runs through the partition of Africa, and this atlas holds none of it — no Berlin conference, no British ultimatum of 1890, no Mapa Cor-de-Rosa, no Italian invasion of 1935 that was fought to avenge this defeat. Every edge that could be written here would have to be written to something that is not a record, and an edge from an Italian defeat in Ethiopia to a Portuguese event would be an invention. The record is sound and the atlas around it is not there yet.
